_notes: Garage Crypto Miner (GAME_DESIGN 17.2; A2 rules from Oscar 2026-10-29). The basic miner (unit 'base', bought on its price pad in the garage) earns from taps only. Idle income starts with the Cooling fan (fan.idlePerHour, a flat amount per game hour); the Second miner (needs the fan) and the Mining rack (needs the second miner) add their idlePerHour. Taps pay tap.base + tap.perChipLevel x chip level. The block lottery rolls once a day at block.rollHour. Power is billed weekly. Offline: offline.gameHoursPerRealHour game hours of idle income per real hour away, capped at offline.maxRealHours. Balance targets are tuned in A6.
_picked: every price, rate, chance and power cost below except tap.base 1, fan $2/h idle (Oscar) and the $25,000 jackpot (design doc)
offline conversion (1 game hour per real hour)
base miner power 5/week (it no longer earns idle)

A6 balance bot (test/balance, 2026-10-30): tap.base 5 (miner ~25-30% of income in the first 10 min), idle fan 1/h, second 1/h, rack 3/h and rack $25,000 (under 5% once the farm opens), block odds per upgrade lowered; jackpot stays $25,000 (design doc)
